supporting_observations.claim: At 13:39:59 UTC, the proxy recorded ana.ruiz's workstation requesting https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecrest-it/tools/main/u.ps1; the corresponding connection to the proxy transferred about 4.9 KB from the server.

At 13:40:10 UTC, a further tunnel from the workstation to raw.githubusercontent.com transferred about 52 KB from the server, but the supplied record does not expose a URL or file content for that tunnel.
The script request and subsequent GitHub tunnel are temporally close to the reported PowerShell-window alert, but these records do not establish that PowerShell downloaded or executed the script.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not include a process-creation event, command line, or PowerShell operational/script-block event establishing whether PowerShell ran during the reported interval.
The proxy records identify the requested script path but do not provide the script body, hash, signature, or repository revision.
The 13:40:10 tunnel record does not reveal the requested resource or its contents.
The supplied records are not sufficient to establish that process and PowerShell telemetry was complete throughout the review window.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell actually opened on WS-ARUIZ-01 at about 13:40 UTC.
Whether u.ps1 or any other script was executed, and what its behavior was.
Whether the script and repository path were authorized or controlled by Pinecrest IT.
Whether the reported window was malicious, an authorized task, or another benign activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Collect endpoint process-tree and command-line telemetry for WS-ARUIZ-01 around 13:39–13:41 UTC, including any available EDR process records.
Review PowerShell Operational logs, script-block/module logging, and available console or command history for the same interval.
Retrieve the proxy response or an authoritative copy of u.ps1 and verify its hash, contents, repository ownership, and revision history.
Ask ana.ruiz and Pinecrest IT whether the script request or PowerShell activity was expected.
unrelated_findings: A logon to WS-RPATEL-01 as raj.patel is recorded with the source address associated in the supplied logs with WS-ARUIZ-01. This warrants separate review against the remote-administration practice; it does not establish a connection to the alerted activity. (T073-00103, T073-00105, T073-00107)

Cisco AnyConnect vpnui.exe ran on WS-ARUIZ-01, although the inventory says there is no VPN. These records establish the application ran, not that a VPN connection was made. (T073-00041, T073-00043, T073-00045)
A Dropbox updater ran on WS-ARUIZ-01; Dropbox is not among the listed approved services. Review separately. (T073-00363, T073-00364, T073-00365, T073-00366)
Explorer recorded a Slack shortcut in ana.ruiz's UserAssist data. This indicates shortcut activity, not by itself that Slack was running or that it relates to the alert. (T073-00362)
